findings.issue: Backend tab state is absent from the URL; initialisation always selects Native and hides a directly targeted #panel-physical. Reload/share/Back cannot preserve the selected backend.
findings.minimal_fix: Read/write a bounded known backend URL state and handle history/hash changes; preserve normal section anchors and NoJS readable panels.
findings.evidence: Actual app.js minimalDOM execution: hash#panel-physical selectsnative+physicalHidden; clickingvirtual leaveshashphysical and zero history calls.

findings.issue: Global a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none} leaves inline documentation links visually identical to surrounding prose until hover.
findings.minimal_fix: Give prose/figcaption links a persistent underline or equivalent visible affordance; keep deliberate nav/button styling.
findings.evidence: Both parentprose and link inheritmuted#9bafbe; theseanchors have no .text-link class or default underline override.
findings.scope: Concrete usability issue, not claimed SC1.4.1 failure: W3C explicitly distinguishes no-styling-difference from color-only indication.

findings.issue: The selected-tab pill outline/state cue is low contrast: #356171 border against #132c37 fill is2.15:1; the pill fill also differs weakly from page background.
findings.minimal_fix: Use a state indicator/border meeting3:1 against adjacent colors, such as theexistingaccent, while retaining visiblefocus.
findings.evidence: Exactsourcecolors/sRGB ratios below; selected label color alone is not a sufficiently distinct non-color state cue.
findings.rule_source: W3C SC1.4.11 selectedstate visual indicators; no claim that all decorative borders need3:1.
